description: This file defines simple methods and workflows related to manufacturing production runs and routing tasks within the Ofbiz framework. It includes logic for editing, adding, and creating production runs, with parameter validation and service calls.

methods.name: editProductionRunRoutingTask
methods.description: Checks parameters and edits a production run routing task, including parameter transformations and service invocation.

methods.name: addProductionRunRoutingTask
methods.description: Validates parameters and adds a new production run routing task via external service.

methods.name: createProductionRun
methods.description: Creates a production run based on parameters, choosing between dependent and single production run creation.
